label: Prohibited AI practices and AI literacy
summary: In force. Bans on unacceptable-risk practices (Article 5) and deployer AI-literacy duties (Article 4) apply.

label: Governance rules and general-purpose AI model obligations
summary: In force. GPAI model transparency obligations and the AI Act governance bodies apply; Commission enforcement powers over GPAI providers begin 2 August 2026.

label: General application of the AI Act
summary: The AI Act's general application date. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 moved Sections 1–3 of the high-risk chapter to fixed later dates while other obligations due on this date continue to apply.

label: Stand-alone Annex III high-risk AI systems
summary: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 fixes this application date for Sections 1–3 of the high-risk chapter as they apply to stand-alone Annex III high-risk systems.

label: High-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products
summary: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 fixes this application date for Sections 1–3 of the high-risk chapter as they apply to Annex I product-embedded systems.
